action.prompt:
A tasks.md file under .kiro/specs/ was just saved.
Log newly completed tasks to KIRO_LOG.md.

1. Let SPEC be the spec folder name. The snapshot is
   .kiro/hooks/state/SPEC-tasks.snapshot.md.
2. If the snapshot does not exist: copy the saved tasks.md
   to it, write no log entry, and stop.
3. Compare the saved tasks.md with the snapshot. A task is
   newly completed when its line was - [ ], - [ ]* or - [-]
   in the snapshot and is - [x] now. Match tasks by number
   and title. Ignore every other change.
4. If no task is newly completed: update the snapshot, stop.
5. For each newly completed task, skip it if KIRO_LOG.md
   already has an entry whose title names this task.
   Otherwise append under ## Entries, using the template in
   KIRO_LOG.md, under 8 lines:
   ### YYYY-MM-DD - Task N: <task title>
   Feature: spec
   What I did: Completed task N of the SPEC spec.
   What Kiro did: what was built = the source files that
   exist for this task (paths in the task or structure.md).
   What changed / what I learned: tests covering it = test
   files that exist under tests/ for those modules plus the
   property IDs named in the task, or none found;
   notable problem = one recorded in this session or the
   task notes, otherwise none recorded.
   Screenshot: TODO
6. Update the snapshot to the saved tasks.md.

Write facts only. Never invent test results, bugs or
measurements. Do not run tests or change other files.
